_source: Official Warhammer Underworlds warband rules PDFs (assets.warhammer-community.com, Embergard edition, files dated 11/11/2024 to 11/02/2026). Text is a paraphrase made from the PDFs' text layer, which is partly garbled (ligatures, icons and dice symbols did not extract); fighter stat lines were unreadable and are not loaded. Concepts are hand-mapped by Claude (claude_review).
entries: Power step, once per game: pick a friendly fighter holding a treasure token; until the end of the next turn its Save is 3.
Power step, once per game: until the end of the next turn, friendly fighters cannot be driven back or pushed.
Power step, once per game: pick a friendly fighter; until the end of the next turn its melee Attack rolls count as having more successes than the Save roll for Drive Back and Overrun.
After a friendly fighter finishes a Move within 1 hex of a treasure token, you may push it 1 hex, ending on a treasure token.
After a Power step: if your warband holds 2 or more treasure tokens in enemy territory, Inspire each friendly fighter.
Once per battle round, after a melee Attack roll by a friendly fighter in friendly territory: re-roll 1 Attack die.
Power step, once per game: push a friendly fighter in friendly territory up to 2 hexes, ending in friendly territory.
Power step, once per game: move a friendly fighter on a feature token in friendly territory to another feature token in friendly territory, then give it a Move token.
Friendly fighters in friendly territory cannot be Flanked or Surrounded.
After an Action step: if a friendly fighter began it in friendly territory and made a successful Attack, Inspire that fighter.
Once per game: a friendly fighter with a Charge token may Charge again; afterwards it takes 2 damage.
Once per game, after picking a weapon for a melee Attack: if the target is Vulnerable, the weapon gains Cleave and Ensnare for that Attack.
Once per game, after an Action step in which your warband slew an enemy with a melee Attack: give Guard tokens to as many friendly fighters as the slain fighter's Bounty.
After a friendly fighter slays an enemy with a melee Attack: it gets a power token, giving its melee weapons +1 Attack dice for its next Attack.
Immediately after a friendly melee Attack slays an enemy: Inspire as many friendly fighters as the slain fighter's Bounty.
Power step, once per game: pick an enemy with a Stagger token, adjacent to a friendly fighter and not Vulnerable; inflict 1 damage on it.
Once per game: pick an enemy with a Stagger token; until the next turn friendly melee weapons get +1 Attack dice against it.
Once per game: pick a friendly fighter on a feature token; until the next turn enemy melee weapons get -1 Attack dice against it.
Immediately after a friendly fighter Delves a feature token: give a Stagger token to each enemy within 2 hexes of it (wording partly unclear in the source).
After the opponent's Action step: if there are more friendly than enemy fighters in neutral territory, Inspire each friendly fighter there.

Once per game: pick a friendly minion, or a friendly fighter with Health 3 or less, adjacent to an enemy; inflict 1 damage on each adjacent enemy, then inflict damage on the picked fighter until it is slain.
Once per game: pick a friendly minion, or a friendly fighter with Health 3 or less, adjacent to an enemy; give each adjacent enemy a Stagger token.
Power step, once per game: push up to 3 friendly minions or fighters with Health 3 or less 1 hex each.
After a successful Attack by your leader: Inspire one friendly fighter or up to 2 friendly minions.
Leader only, once per battle round: place a slain friendly fighter on an empty starting hex in friendly territory; if it is not a minion, damage it until it is Vulnerable.

Roll 3 Attack dice (the same fighter at most once per battle round); a result on the Locus table gives that ability until the end of the round: Blades of Shyish (a friendly fighter's melee weapons gain Critical Grievous), Spirit Gale (a friendly fighter +1 Move), Prison of Grief (an enemy's weapons -1 Attack dice), Spectral Grasp (an enemy -1 Move).
If an enemy is slain while a Locus ability persists: Inspire as many friendly fighters as its Bounty.
unassigned (printed under a Chaos header, Orruk themes)
Once per game, after picking an Attack's target that is Flanked or Surrounded: certain dice results also count as successes (symbols did not extract).
unassigned (printed under a Chaos header, Orruk themes)
Power step, once per game: until the end of the battle round, hexes adjacent to friendly fighters also count as stagger hexes.
unassigned (printed under a Chaos header, Orruk themes)
Once per game, after picking an Attack's target: the attacker's melee Attack rolls count as having more successes than the Save roll for Drive Back and Overrun.

Start of the first Action step each battle round, if your leader is on the battlefield: you may discard an Upgrade equipped by a friendly fighter, then add a Ploy from your Power discard pile to your hand (each Ploy at most once per game).
After your Action step: Inspire each friendly fighter adjacent to a damaged enemy.
Once per game, immediately after an enemy Charges: a friendly fighter adjacent to the charger may Attack it.
Once per game, after picking a damaged friendly fighter to Attack: its weapons get +1 Attack dice for that Attack.
Once per game, after a friendly fighter is picked as a melee target while another friendly fighter is adjacent to it: its Save is 2 for that Attack.
Start of the first Action step each battle round: you may push each friendly fighter 1 hex; each push must end closer to, or adjacent to, an enemy leader.
After a friendly fighter Attacks an enemy that is Flanked or Surrounded: Inspire the attacker and each friendly fighter adjacent to the target.
While one of Zondara or Ferlain is slain, the other destined fighter has +1 Move and +1 Attack dice on its weapons.
Power step, once per battle round: pick the 2 friendly destined fighters; heal one, then push the other up to 3 hexes towards it.

Immediately after a friendly minion Delves: either that minion uses Unearth (draw Power cards equal to the number of slain friendly fighters) or a friendly leader uses Exhume (raise a slain friendly minion and place it adjacent to the fighter that Delved).
When a friendly fighter gets a Raise token, Inspire it; when a destined fighter gets its second or later Upgrade, Inspire the other destined fighter.
Once per game, after a friendly fighter adjacent to another friendly fighter is picked to use a Core ability: push it 1 hex.
Once per game, after a friendly fighter adjacent to another friendly fighter is picked to use a Core ability: give it a Guard token.
Power step, once per game: a friendly fighter and another fighter adjacent to it swap places.
A friendly leader raises a slain friendly minion and places it on an empty starting hex, giving it a Raise token.
After resolving a Ploy that picked a friendly fighter: Inspire that fighter.
Friendly melee weapons have Grievous against targets that are Flanked or Surrounded.
While Skritch is slain, Krrk is a leader.
Once per game, after picking a target for an Attack: the target counts as Surrounded for that Attack.
Power step, once per game: remove your leader and place it in an empty hex adjacent to 2 friendly fighters, then give it a Charge token.
Once per game, after a friendly fighter with no Raise tokens is slain by an enemy melee Attack: inflict 1 damage on that enemy.
Only if your leader has no Charge tokens: your leader and up to 2 other friendly fighters Move.
Only if your leader has no Charge tokens: raise up to 2 slain friendly fighters on different empty starting hexes in your territory.
When a friendly fighter gets a Raise token, Inspire it; once friendly fighters have 3 or more Raise tokens in total, Inspire your leader.
Once per game, after your Action step: push each friendly fighter as many hexes as the battle round number; each push must end in enemy territory.
Once per game, after your Action step: a friendly fighter not in enemy territory and not adjacent to an enemy may Move.
Once per game, after your Action step: give a Guard token to a damaged friendly fighter in enemy territory.

After an Inspired, Vulnerable friendly fighter in enemy territory uses a Core ability, choose: Uninspire and heal it (it cannot be healed or Inspired again this round), or roll Attack dice equal to the battle round against an enemy within 3 hexes, inflicting 1 damage per hit result (the result symbol did not extract).
After a friendly fighter's second Attack in the same phase, if it used a different weapon each time: Inspire it.
After an enemy's failed Attack against a friendly fighter: during the next turn that fighter's weapons gain Cleave and Ensnare against that enemy.
After an enemy's failed Attack against a friendly Cephanyr: push Cephanyr as many hexes as the battle round number.
Power step, once per game: pick an Inspired enemy; its owner chooses to Uninspire it or let you draw Power cards equal to the battle round.

Only while your leader is on the battlefield with no Charge tokens: draw a line from the leader through an adjacent hex to the battlefield edge; the first enemy on it takes 1 damage and a Stagger token (blocked hexes stop the line).
At the start of each combat phase, Inspire as many friendly fighters as the battle round number; at the start of each round, Uninspire each friendly fighter.
Once per game, after Brodus picks a weapon for an Attack: it gets +X Attack dice, X = the battle round number.
Once per game, after the opponent picks a weapon to attack a friendly shield-bearer: weapon abilities cannot be used for that Attack.
Once per game, after you pick a weapon for an Attack by a friendly shield-bearer: the weapon has +1 Range for that Attack.
Friendly fighters with no Move or Charge tokens cannot be driven back.
After an Attack roll or Save roll for a friendly fighter that shows a certain result (the symbol did not extract): Inspire that fighter.
Once per game, after your Action step: push a friendly fighter 1 hex.
Power step, once per game: draw Power cards equal to the number of damaged enemy fighters.
Once per game, after an Action step: roll a dice for each damaged enemy; on a certain result (symbol did not extract) inflict 1 damage on it.

After your Action step, once per fighter per turn: a friendly fighter with no Charge tokens rolls an Attack dice against an adjacent enemy that is not Vulnerable; on a certain result (symbol did not extract) inflict 1 damage.

Instead of playing a Ploy in the opponent's Power step, discard Ploys for effects that last until the end of your next turn and add up: 1 card, friendly fighters +1 Move; 2, enemies are Flanked; 3, friendly weapons +1 Attack dice.
After damaging an enemy with Krule Stab: Inspire the fighter that used it.

At the start of the combat phase choose one hymn; while you have 2 or more friendly fighters, each can use it: Charged Aura (friendly fighters cannot be Flanked), Reckless Abandon (instead of taking a Charge token, a fighter may take 1 damage), Faithful Dynamos (friendly weapons have Stagger).
Power step, once per game: a friendly fighter Moves.
Once per game, after your Action step: Uninspire a friendly fighter, then inflict 1 damage on an enemy adjacent to it.
Once per game, after your Action step: heal a friendly fighter that was conducting during that step.
When a friendly fighter attacks at range, the distance to the target counts 1 less for each friendly fighter between them; those fighters become conducting.
Friendly fighters start the game Inspired; after an Action step in which a friendly fighter was conducting, Inspire it; after a friendly fighter's successful Attack, Uninspire it.
